notes: Korean move + ability names extracted from gMoveNames @ 0x2470E0 and gAbilityNames @ 0x24FC8C in the 2024 patched ROM. Each entry is a sequence of 16-bit BE codepoints into a custom hangul font table. The codepoint -> hangul map was triangulated against PokeAPI canonical Korean names.
Move firstAreaEncountered is set from the canonical FRLG TM/HM acquisition area when applicable, else rom_mined.
